ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r3.claim: The messengers’ mission is to purify followers spiritually; those seeking reform deserve attention, while people without that urge do not advance the preaching mission despite worldly importance.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r3.anchor: the real objective of the messengers of God is to spiritually purify their followers

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r4.claim: The earnest seeker is marked by a desire for inner purification and by benefiting from reminders.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p175/r4.anchor: he is desirous of his inner-purification and he is one who benefits from being reminded

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r1.claim: True students either come with a question and seek guidance or come to hear instruction and learn from answers to others; either purpose makes them worthy of attention.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r1.anchor: there were two types of people among them: one, people who had a question regarding their instruction and training

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r2.claim: People who come only to be pampered should stay home and await their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p176/r2.anchor: As far as people who want to be pampered are concerned, they should sit at home

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p179/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p179/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p179/r1.claim: The pronoun’s antecedent is dhikr in verse 4, referring to the Qur’an; the masculine form points to its real meaning, and similar usage occurs in earlier sūrahs.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p179/r1.anchor: Examples of such usage can be seen in previous sūrahs

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r7.speaker: الجمهور؛ الأعرج، عاصم في رواية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r7.claim: The majority double ذ and ك in يذكر through assimilation; the others use a silent ذ with rounded ك.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r7.anchor: والظاهر مصب يدريك على جملة الترجي، فالمعنى: لا تدري ما هو مترجى منه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r8.speaker: الجمهور، عاصم، الأعرج، أبو حيوة، ابن أبي عبلة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r8.claim: The majority raise فتنفعه with يذكر; the other named readers put both verbs in the subjunctive. Al-Basrians posit implied أن after ف, while al-Zamakhshari treats it as answering hope.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r8.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: فتنفعه، برفع العين عطفا على أو يذكر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r9.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r9.claim: He says the subjunctive answers a wish; Abu Hayyan objects that the clause expresses hope, not a wish.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p406/r9.anchor: قال ابن عطية: في جواب التمني، لأن قوله: أو يذكر في حكم قوله لعله يزكى

BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.claim: The surah explains the call to warn those who fear by using resurrection to purify receptive hearts; human creation and the cycle of food prove God’s power, making rejection astonishing.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.anchor: بأن المراد الأعظم تزكية القابل للخشية بالتخويف بالقيامة

SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r1.speaker: عاصم
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r1.claim: ʿĀṣim reads فتَنْفَعَه in the accusative, while the others read it in the nominative; the accusative is a response to hope, a Kufan analysis, comparable to فأطلع in 40:37.
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r1.anchor: قرأ عاصم بنصبه، والباقون برفعه. فأما نصبه فعلى جواب الترجي كقوله: فأطلع

SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r2.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyyah calls it a response to wishing because أو يذكر has the same sense as لعله يزكى; the Shaykh says it is hope, not wishing. Al-Samīn says Ibn ʿAṭiyyah means an implied wish, as Abū al-Baqāʾ’s wording confirms.
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عطية: " في جواب التمني؛ لأن قوله " أو يذكر " في حكم قوله " لعله يزكى ". قال الشيخ: " وهذا ليس تمنيا إنما هو ترج "

SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r3.speaker: مكي
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r3.claim: Makkī says the accusative makes the ف a response to لعل because it is nonassertive, resembling a wish or question; he notes that Basran grammarians do not recognize this analysis.
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r3.anchor: وقال مكي: " من نصبه جعله جواب " لعل " بالفاء لأنه غير موجب فأشبه التمني والاستفهام، وهو غير معروف عند البصريين

SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r4.speaker: عاصم في رواية والأعرج
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r4.claim: In one transmission, ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿraj read أو يذكر with a still dhāl, a light ungeminated kāf, and ḍamma, as the present tense of ذكر.
SAMIN-DURR:80:4/r4.anchor: وقرأ عاصم في وراية والأعرج " أو يذكر " بسكون الذال وتخفيف الكاف مضومة مضارع ذكر

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r1.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي وأحسب ابن عامر
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r1.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and probably Ibn ʿĀmir read فتنفعه in the indicative; ʿĀṣim reads the accusative.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r1.anchor: قرأ ابن كثير ونافع وأبو عمرو وحمزة والكسائي، وأحسب ابن عامر: فتنفعه [4] رفع. وقرأ عاصم

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r2.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r2.claim: The indicative coordinates with the preceding raised verb: as though the meaning were that perhaps he will remember and the reminder will benefit him.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r2.anchor: قال أبو علي: من رفع: فتنفعه عطفه على ما تقدم من المرفوع، كأنه: لعله تنفعه الذكرى

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r3.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r3.claim: The accusative is a fa-answer with an implicit أن because the preceding clause is non-positive; similar constructions follow a negation, command, prohibition, question, or offer.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r3.anchor: وقول عاصم على أنه جواب بالفاء، لأن المتقدم غير موجب، فكأن قوله: يذكر في تقدير المعطوف

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r4.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r4.claim: Al-Fārisī compares the subjunctive after fa in لعلي أبلغ الأسباب فأطلع and وأطلع, cited from 40:36–37 and 19:78.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p376/r4.anchor: كذلك قوله: لعلي أبلغ الأسباب ... فأطلع [غافر/ 36، 37] وأطلع [مريم/ 78]

NASHR:v2p397#2/r17.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p397#2/r17.speaker: عاصم
NASHR:v2p397#2/r17.claim: ʿĀṣim reads فتَنفعَه with the accusative ending on the ʿayn.
NASHR:v2p397#2/r17.anchor: فقرأ عاصم بنصب العين، وقرأ الباقون برفعها.

NASHR:v2p397#2/r18.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p397#2/r18.speaker: الباقون
NASHR:v2p397#2/r18.claim: The remaining readers read فتَنفعُه with the nominative ending on the ʿayn.
NASHR:v2p397#2/r18.anchor: فقرأ عاصم بنصب العين، وقرأ الباقون برفعها.

QIRAAT-ER:80:4:4#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:80:4:4#1/r1.speaker: CE
QIRAAT-ER:80:4:4#1/r1.claim: The CE case or mood variant raises the final vowel, making the benefit clause sound more independent than tanfaʿahu.
QIRAAT-ER:80:4:4#1/r1.anchor: Canonical case/mood variant raises the final vowel, allowing the benefit clause to sound more independent

ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r1.claim: Yadhdhakkaru means that he takes admonition; the reminder that benefits him is the Prophet's exhortation and preaching.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r1.anchor: أو يذكر أي يتعظ فتنفعه الذكرى أي ذكراك وموعظتك

ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r6.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r6.claim: On that analysis purification can mean total cleansing from sin, while remembering can benefit him if he does not attain complete purification; the author calls a further proposed distinction between obligatory and optional learning weak.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r6.anchor: أي لعله يتطهر بما يقتبس منك من أوضار الأثم بالكلية أو يتذكر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r10.speaker: الأعرج وعاصم في رواية
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r10.claim: Al-Aʿraj and one transmission from Asim read yadhdhakkaru with a still dhāl and a damma on kāf.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r10.anchor: وقرأ الأعرج وعاصم في رواية أو يذكر بسكون الذال وضم الكاف

ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r11.speaker: الأكثر وعاصم والأعرج وأبو حيوة وابن أبي عبلة والزعفراني
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r11.claim: Most readers raise tanfaʿuhu by coordination with yadhdhakkaru; Asim in the common reading, al-Aʿraj, Abu Haywa, Ibn Abi Abla, and al-Zaʿfarani read it in the accusative, supplied by an implied an for Basrans or as the response to hope for Kufans.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r11.anchor: وقرأ الأكثر فتنفعه بالرفع عطفا على يذكر وبالنصب قرأ عاصم في المشهور

ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r12.speaker: الكشف
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r12.claim: Al-Kashf says the accusative reading favors taking the pronoun as the disbeliever, since hope then approaches a wish for an unlikely outcome; under the prior interpretation, the reading can instead reinforce the sense of qualified, incomplete purification.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p40/r12.anchor: وفي الكشف أن النصب يؤيد رجوع ضمير لعله على الكافر لا شمام الترجي معنى التمني

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p105/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p105/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p105/r8.claim: Tadhakkur is the effect of reminding: a known matter returns to the mind after being forgotten; the word derives from dhikr.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p105/r8.anchor: والتذكر : حصول أثر التذكير ، فهو خطور أمر معلوم في الذهن بعد نسيانه إذ هو مشتق من الذكر بضم الذال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#5/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#5/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#5/r7.claim: Tadhakkur is the effect of reminding: a known matter returns to the mind after being forgotten; the word derives from dhikr with a ḍamma on the dhāl.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#5/r7.anchor: والتذكر : حصول أثر التذكير ، فهو خطور أمر معلوم في الذهن بعد نسيانه إذ هو مشتق من الذكر بضم الذال .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r4.speaker: الأعرج
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r4.claim: Al-Araj reads يذكر with a still dhāl and a damma on kāf; this reading is also reported from Asim.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r4.anchor: وقرأ الأعرج. «يذكر» بسكون الذال وضم الكاف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r5.speaker: جمهور السبعة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r5.claim: The majority of the Seven read فتَنْفَعَهُ with a damma on the final vowel, coordinating it with what precedes.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r5.anchor: وقرأ جمهور السبعة: «فتنفعه» بضم العين على العطف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r6.speaker: عاصم والأعرج
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r6.claim: Asim alone and al-Araj read the verb in the accusative as the response to the implied hope, since أو يذكر is understood as لعله يزكى.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p437/r6.anchor: وقرأ عاصم وحده والأعرج: «فتنفعه» بالنصب في جواب التمني

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r1.claim: Yadhakkar means to take admonition from the Quran’s teachings, so the reminder may benefit him.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r1.anchor: أو يذكر أي يتعظ بما يتعلمه من مواعظ القرآن فتنفعه الذكرى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r2.speaker: حفص عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r2.claim: Hafs from Asim reads fatanfaʿahu with accusative fatḥa on the final vowel; the others read it nominative.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r2.anchor: قرأ حفص عن عاصم فتنفعه بفتح العين والباقون برفعها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r3.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r3.claim: Al-Zajjaj says the accusative is a response to laʿalla, while the nominative coordinates with yuzakka.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p27#3/r3.anchor: قال الزجاج من نصب فعلى جواب لعل ومن رفع فعلى العطف على يزكى

JISHUMI:v10p7280/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r4.speaker: الحسن وجماعة
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r4.claim: They say it was revealed when Ibn Umm Maktūm interrupted the Prophet's effort to convert Meccan leaders; the Prophet turned back to them and God rebuked him.
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r4.anchor: قيل: نزلت الآيات في عبد الله بن أم مكتوم أتى رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم -، وهو يناجي عتبة بن ربيعة

JISHUMI:v10p7280/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r5.speaker: الحسن وجماعة
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r5.claim: Afterward the Prophet honored him, welcomed him as the man over whom his Lord reproached him, and asked his needs.
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r5.anchor: فكان رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - بعد ذلك يكرمه، وإذا رآه قال: مرحبا بمن عاتبني ربي فيه،

JISHUMI:v10p7280/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r6.speaker: أنس
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r6.claim: Anas says he saw Ibn Umm Maktūm at al-Qādisiyya in armor with a black banner.
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r6.anchor: قال أنس: رأيته يوم القادسية، عليه درع، ومعه راية سوداء.

JISHUMI:v10p7280/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd relates the saying that if the Messenger concealed revelation, he would have concealed this passage.
JISHUMI:v10p7280/r7.anchor: قال ابن زيد: كان يقال: لو كتم رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - شيئا من الوحي لكتم هذا.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r13.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r13.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r13.claim: One reading takes the pronoun as the blind man: he may purify himself by learning religious law and shedding sin, or take admonition that helps him obey; the Prophet could not know what might follow.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r13.anchor: أي يتطهر بما يتلقن من الشرائع من بعض أوضار الإثم ( { أو يذكر } أو يتعظ { فتنفعه } ذكراك

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r14.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r14.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r14.claim: Another reading takes the pronoun as the unbeliever: the Prophet hoped Islam and the reminder would bring him toward truth, though he could not know that this would happen.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r14.anchor: وقيل : الضمير في { لعله } للكافر . يعني أنك طمعت في أن يتزكى بالإسلام

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r15.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r15.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r15.claim: Fatanfaʿahu is read in the indicative, coordinated with yadhdhakkaru, or in the subjunctive as a response to laʿalla; the latter syntax is paralleled elsewhere.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p701/r15.anchor: وقرىء ( فتنفعه ) ، بالرفع عطفا على يذكر . وبالنصب جوابا للعل ، كقوله : { فأطلع إلى إلاه موسى }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r1.anchor: ﴿ أو يذكر ﴾ يتعظ ﴿ فتنفعه ﴾ نصبه عاصم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r2.speaker: عاصم
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r2.claim: Nasafi attributes the accusative reading to ʿĀṣim, notes al-Aʿshā, and construes it as a response to laʿalla.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r2.anchor: نصبه عاصم غير الأعشى جوابا للعل

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r3.speaker: غيره
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r3.claim: Other readers use the nominative, coordinating the verb with yadhdhakkar.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r3.anchor: وغيره رفعه عطفا على يذكر ﴿ الذكرى ﴾ ذكراك

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r4.claim: Al-dhikrā means the Prophet's reminder or admonition.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r5.claim: The Prophet cannot know whether the man will purify himself or take heed; knowing that prospect would have prevented his neglect.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#2/r5.anchor: أى انك لا تدى ما هو مترقب منه من تزك أو تذكر ولو دريت لما فرط ذلك منك

BURSEVI:v10p258/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r4.speaker: السهيلي
BURSEVI:v10p258/r4.claim: Al-Suhaylī says the Prophet hoped for the conversion of the pagan, identified as al-Walīd or Umayya, whose Islam might have brought many others to Islam.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r4.anchor: وهو الوليد أو أمية وكان مثله يسلم بإسلامه بشر كثير فكلم نبيه عليه السلام

BURSEVI:v10p258/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r5.speaker: السهيلي
BURSEVI:v10p258/r5.claim: Al-Suhaylī notes that Ibn Umm Maktūm was already Muslim and had learned his religious essentials, while the pagans had not accepted Islam.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r5.anchor: وأما أولئك الكفار فما كانوا قد أسلموا وكان إسلامهم سببا لإسلام جمع عظيم

BURSEVI:v10p258/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p258/r6.claim: Even if the Prophet sought a greater benefit, his action outwardly suggested preferring the rich and disregarding the poor man’s hurt, so God reproached him for leaving the better course.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r6.anchor: إلا أن ظاهر ما فعله الرسول عليه السلام يوهم تقديم الأغنياء على الفقراء وقلة المبالاة بانكسار قلوب الفقراء

BURSEVI:v10p258/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p258/r9.claim: Yadhakkaru is contracted from yatadhakkaru and means that the man may take heed.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r9.anchor: بتشديدين أيضا أصله يتذكر والتذكر هو الاتعاظ يعني باخود ند كيرد

BURSEVI:v10p258/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p258/r10.claim: If he does not reach complete purification, the Prophet’s exhortation may still benefit him.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r10.anchor: أي فتنفعه موعظتك إن لم يبلغ درجة التزكي التام

BURSEVI:v10p258/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p258/r11.speaker: الكشاف
BURSEVI:v10p258/r11.claim: Al-Kashshāf explains that the Prophet could not know whether the man would attain purification or recollection; if he had known, he would not have neglected him.
BURSEVI:v10p258/r11.anchor: المعنى إنك لا تدري ما هو مترقب منه من تزكى أو تذكر ولو دريت لما فرط ذلك منك

RAZI-FULL:v31p52/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p52/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p52/r3.claim: The reading fatannaʿuhu in the nominative coordinates with yadhdhakkaru; in the accusative it is a response to laʿalla, as in Ghāfir 40:37.
RAZI-FULL:v31p52/r3.anchor: وقرىء فتنفعه بالرفع عطفا على يذكر ، وبالنصب جوابا للعل

TAB-FULL:v24p106/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r3.claim: Yadhakkar means to remember and reflect, so that the reminder benefits him through consideration and admonition.
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r3.anchor: أو يتذكر فتنفعه الذكرى: يعني يعتبر

TAB-FULL:v24p106/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r4.claim: The preferred nominative reading of fanfaʿahu coordinates it with yadhakkar.
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r4.anchor: والقراءة على رفع: فتنفعه عطفا به على قوله

TAB-FULL:v24p106/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r5.speaker: عاصم
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r5.claim: ʿĀṣim is reported to read fanfaʿahu both in the accusative and in the nominative.
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r5.anchor: وقد روي عن عاصم النصب فيه والرفع

TAB-FULL:v24p106/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r6.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r6.claim: The accusative reading treats the verb as a result clause following the fāʾ after laʿalla.
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r6.anchor: والنصب على أن تجعله جوابا بالفاء للعل

TAB-FULL:v24p106/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r7.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r7.claim: A rajaz poem is cited to illustrate this accusative construction; its verb tanqaʿ is transmitted in both nominative and accusative forms.
TAB-FULL:v24p106/r7.anchor: كما قال الشاعر: [البحر الرجز] عل صروف الدهر

TABRISI:80:20/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:20/r6.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:80:20/r6.claim: The passage is said to have been revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum, also named Abdullah ibn Shurayh ibn Malik ibn Rabiʿa al-Fihri, when he came as the Prophet was urging Quraysh leaders toward Islam.
TABRISI:80:20/r6.anchor: قيل نزلت الآيات في عبد الله بن أم مكتوم وهو عبد الله بن شريح بن مالك ابن ربيعة الفهري

TABRISI:80:20/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:20/r7.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:80:20/r7.claim: The Prophet was speaking with ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa, Abu Jahl, al-ʿAbbas, Ubayy, and Umayya ibn Khalaf when Ibn Umm Maktum repeatedly asked to be taught; the Prophet turned away, thinking the leaders might scorn a following of blind people and slaves.
TABRISI:80:20/r7.anchor: وذلك أنه أتى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يناجي عتبة بن ربيعة وأبا جهل بن هشام والعباس بن عبد المطلب وأبيا وأمية ابني خلف

TABRISI:80:20/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:20/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
TABRISI:80:20/r8.claim: Afterward the Prophet honored Ibn Umm Maktum, greeted him as the man for whom his Lord had reproached him, asked about his needs, and appointed him deputy in Medina twice.
TABRISI:80:20/r8.anchor: وكان رسول الله بعد ذلك يكرمه

TABRISI:80:20/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:20/r9.speaker: أنس بن مالك
TABRISI:80:20/r9.claim: Anas ibn Malik says he saw Ibn Umm Maktum at al-Qadisiyya wearing armor and carrying a black standard.
TABRISI:80:20/r9.anchor: وقال أنس بن مالك: فرأيته يوم القادسية وعليه درع ومعه راية سوداء

TABRISI:80:20/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:20/r10.speaker: المرتضى علم الهدى
TABRISI:80:20/r10.claim: Al-Murtada rejects identifying the passage's subject as the Prophet: the text does not name him, and frowning at a believing seeker or preferring rich people to the poor conflicts with his noble character.
TABRISI:80:20/r10.anchor: قال المرتضى علم الهدى قدس الله روحه: ليس في ظاهر الآية دلالة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r1.claim: He may remember and take admonition from what the Qur’an teaches.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r1.anchor: {أو يذكر} أي يتذكر فيتعظ بما يعلمه من مواعظ القرآن.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r2.claim: The dhikrā is the admonition that benefits him.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r3.speaker: قراءة العامة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r3.claim: The general reading has tanfaʿahu in the nominative, coordinated with the preceding nominative verb.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r3.anchor: وقراءة العامة الرفع في: (فتنفعه (¬6)) بالعطف على ما تقدم من المرفوع

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r4.speaker: من نصب
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r4.claim: Those who read tanfaʿahu in the accusative treat it as the answer to laʿalla, as in “so that I may reach the ways, then ascend.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p212#2/r4.anchor: ومن نصب (¬7) فعلى جواب لعل (¬8) كقوله: {لعلي أبلغ الأسباب * فأطلع} [غافر: 36 - 37]

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r4.claim: The sūra rebukes preferring the wealthy and privileged to poor believers, then recalls human dependence on God's care despite ingratitude and turns to resurrection, recompense, and warning.
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r4.anchor: فغرض السورة عتاب من يقدم الأغنياء والمترفين على الضعفاء والمساكين من المؤمنين فيرفع أهل الدنيا ويضع أهل الآخرة

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r8.claim: The clause beginning “what will make you know” is circumstantial to the subject of “frowned and turned away.”

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r9.claim: Tazakkā means becoming pure through good action after reflection; the reflection is taking heed and awakening to true belief.
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r9.anchor: والمراد بالتزكي التطهر بعمل صالح بعد التذكر الذي هو الاتعاظ والانتباه للاعتقاد الحق

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r10.claim: The reminder benefits by inviting purification through faith and righteous action; the blind visitor might learn and purify himself or be admonished and remember.
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r10.anchor: ونفع الذكرى هو دعوتها إلى التزكي بالإيمان والعمل الصالح

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r11.claim: The first two verses speak in the third person, distancing the rebuke; the next two switch to direct address, intensifying reproach and accountability.
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r11.anchor: ويزيد شدة بإتيان الآيتين الأوليين في سياق الغيبة لما فيه من الإعراض عن المشافهة والدلالة على تشديد الإنكار

TABATABAI:80:1-4/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r13.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r13.claim: On the view that the Prophet is the one reproached, third-person wording honors him by implying someone else acted; the later direct address also honors him through intimacy after estrangement.
TABATABAI:80:1-4/r13.anchor: وقيل - بناء على كون المراد بالمعاتب هو النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم - أن في التعبير عنه أولا بضمير الغيبة إجلالا له

TABATABAI:80:13-16/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:13-16/r12.speaker: مجمع البيان
TABATABAI:80:13-16/r12.claim: Al-Majmaʿ recounts that Abdullah ibn Shurayḥ ibn Mālik ibn Rabīʿa al-Fihri, Ibn Umm Maktūm, interrupted the Prophet's appeal to ʿUtba, Abū Jahl, al-ʿAbbās, Ubayy, and Umayya ibn Khalaf to ask for teaching; the Prophet frowned, fearing the elites would scorn followers who were blind or enslaved, then turned back to them.
TABATABAI:80:13-16/r12.anchor: في المجمع قيل نزلت الآيات في عبد الله بن أم مكتوم وهو عبد الله بن شريح بن مالك بن ربيعة الفهروي

TABRISI:80:1-23/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:1-23/r1.speaker: عاصم
TABRISI:80:1-23/r1.claim: ʿAsim, except al-Aʿsha and al-Barjumi, reads فتَنفعَه in the accusative; the others read it nominative.
TABRISI:80:1-23/r1.anchor: قرأ عاصم غير الأعشى والبرجمي فتنفعه بالنصب والباقون بالرفع

TABRISI:80:1-23/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:1-23/r6.speaker: أبو علي
TABRISI:80:1-23/r6.claim: Abu ʿAli explains the nominative as coordination with an earlier nominative; the accusative makes the clause a response with faʾ because the preceding statement is non-positive.
TABRISI:80:1-23/r6.anchor: من قرأ فتنفعه بالرفع عطفه على ما تقدم من المرفوع

TABRISI:80:1-23/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:1-23/r7.speaker: أبو علي
TABRISI:80:1-23/r7.claim: The accusative reading is illustrated by Moses’ statement, “so that I may reach the means … and look.”
TABRISI:80:1-23/r7.anchor: وكذا قوله لعلي أبلغ الأسباب أسباب السماوات فأطلع

TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r8.claim: The blind man might become purified through good works and learning, or remember and heed Qurʾanic admonition so that the reminder benefits his religion.
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r8.anchor: أي لعل هذا الأعمى { يزكى } يتطهر بالعمل الصالح

TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r9.claim: God shows great courtesy: He does not directly say “you frowned,” but shifts to direct address only after passing over the frown.
TABRISI:80:1-23#2/r9.anchor: وفي هذا لطف من الله عظيم لنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ لم يخاطبه في باب العبوس

QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r9.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r9.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r9.claim: The seeker may take admonition, so that the reminder benefits him.

FARRA:v3p235/r6.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p235/r6.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p235/r6.claim: Readers agree on رفع فتَنفعه; نصب after فاء جواب لعل would also be valid, as an anonymous poem illustrates.
FARRA:v3p235/r6.anchor: بالرفع، ولو كان نصبا على جواب الفاء للعل- كان صوابا

NAHHAS:v5p149/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p149/r6.claim: The underlying يتذكر assimilates tāʾ into dhāl because the two sounds are close.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r6.anchor: الأصل يتذكر دغمت التاء في الذال لقربها منها

NAHHAS:v5p149/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r7.speaker: عاصم
NAHHAS:v5p149/r7.claim: The well-known transmission from Asim has فتنفعه in the subjunctive.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r7.anchor: الرواية معروفة عن عاصم أنه قرأ ( فتنفعه الذكرى ) بالنصب

NAHHAS:v5p149/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r8.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v5p149/r8.claim: Al-Farra permits the subjunctive reading of فتنفعه, though he had not heard it recited that way.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r8.anchor: وزعم الفراء أنه يجوز النصب ولم يقرأ به

NAHHAS:v5p149/r9.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r9.speaker: الكوفيون
NAHHAS:v5p149/r9.claim: The Kufans analyze the subjunctive as the response to لعل; Basrans do not recognize a subjunctive response to لعل.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r9.anchor: والكوفيون يقولون هو جواب لعل ولا يعرف البصريون جواب لعل بالنصب

NAHHAS:v5p149/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r10.speaker: علي بن سليمان
NAHHAS:v5p149/r10.claim: Ali ibn Sulayman says he knows no basis for the subjunctive despite Asim’s authoritative reading, but allows coordination governed by أو.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r10.anchor: ما أعرف للنصب وجها وإن كان عاصم مع جلالته قد قرأ به إلا أن أو يجوز أن تنصب ما بعدها

NAHHAS:v5p149/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p149/r11.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p149/r11.claim: Al-Nahhas notes a possible coordination with the element after أو, illustrated by an unnamed poet’s فنعذرا after أو نموت.
NAHHAS:v5p149/r11.anchor: فقد يجوز أن يعطفه على ما ينتصب بعد أو

ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r4.claim: The accusative reading of tanfaʿahu makes it a result dependent on laʿalla.

ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p283/r5.claim: The nominative reading coordinates tanfaʿu with yuzakkā.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p169/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p169/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p169/r1.claim: ʿAbasa pairs with al-Nāziʿāt and shares its central theme, discourse style, and reasoning; the changed sequence of topics gives this sūrah its distinct majesty.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p169/r1.anchor: There is no basic difference between the central theme of both sūrahs.

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p362#2/r4.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p362#2/r4.speaker: عاصم
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p362#2/r4.claim: Rafʿ is the consensus reading except for a reported nasb reading from ʿĀṣim; the author refers to its discussion in Sūrat al-Muʾmin.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p362#2/r4.anchor: الرفع فيه اجماع الا ما روى من نصبه عن عاصم وقد ذكر في سورة المؤمن

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r3.claim: He may take heed, so the reminder benefits him.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r4.speaker: عاصم، والعامة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r4.claim: Asim reads the verb in the subjunctive as the result of لعل with fa; the general reading has the indicative, coordinating it with يذكر.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p336/r4.anchor: قرأ عاصم: "فتنفعه" بنصب العين على جواب "لعل" بالفاء، وقراءة العامة

BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r2.claim: The man may take heed and benefit from the Prophet's admonition.

BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r4.speaker: عاصم
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r4.claim: Asim reads the verb in the subjunctive as a result clause after laʿalla.
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:3-8/r4.anchor: وقرأ عاصم فتنفعه بالنصب جوابا للعل

BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r11.claim: He may remember something that leads to purification, even by a small step out of unbelief; no amount of good should be dismissed.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r11.anchor: أو يقع منه التذكر لشيء يكون سببا لزكائه وتذكره ولو كان ذلك منه على أدنى الوجوه المخرجة من الكفر

BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r12.claim: The reminder benefits him immediately after and because of his recollection; the phrasing hints that the Prophet turned away to help the other man’s purification and recollection.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r12.anchor: وفي ذلك إيماء إلى أن الإعراض كان لتزكية غيره وتذكره

BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p323/r13.claim: The accusative reading of فتَنْفَعَهُ construes it as the response to laʿalla.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p326/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p326/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p326/r1.claim: Ibn Umm Maktūm gained an immense, lasting reputation from this event, unlike Pharaoh, who was turned away and neither purified himself nor benefited from the reminder.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p326/r1.anchor: فيا له صيتا ما أجله بخلاف من قدم ذكره ممن طرد فلم يتزك ولم ينتفع بالذكرى حين قصد بها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r3.claim: ‘Or remember’ coordinates with ‘purify’: the two equally important outcomes are new knowledge through guidance or recalling what was forgotten.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r3.anchor: وجملة { أو يذكر } عطف على { يزكى } ، أي ما يدريك أن يحصل أحد الأمرين وكلاهما مهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r4.claim: Al-dhikrā is the verbal noun of reminding.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r5.claim: The wording omits the parallel statement that purification benefits him, because both purification and reminder obviously benefit him.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r5.anchor: وفي قوله تعالى : { فتنفعه الذكرى } اكتفاء عن أن يقول : فينفعه التزكي وتنفعه الذكرى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r6.claim: The reminder is the Qur’an, which recalls what people neglect; Ibn Umm Maktūm had asked about Qur’anic verses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r6.anchor: والذكرى : هو القرآن لأنه يذكر الناس بما يغفلون عنه قال تعالى : { وما هو إلا ذكر للعالمين }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r7.claim: Ibn Umm Maktūm’s question included asking about verses of the Qur’an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r7.anchor: فقد كان فيما سأل عنه ابن أم مكتوم آيات من القرآن .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r8.speaker: الجمهور
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r8.claim: The majority read fatanfaʿuhu in the indicative, coordinated with yadhdhakkaru.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r8.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور : { فتنفعه } بالرفع عطفا على ( يذكر ) .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r9.speaker: عاصم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r9.claim: ʿĀṣim reads fatanfaʿahu in the subjunctive as the response to laʿallahu yatazakkā.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p106/r9.anchor: وقرأه عاصم بالنصب في جواب : { لعله يزكى } .

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p319#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p319#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p319#2/r2.claim: The blind man might attain inner purification, or be admonished and deterred from forbidden acts so that the reminder benefits him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p319#2/r2.anchor: أي: يحصل له زكاة وطهارة في نفسه. (أو يذكر فتنفعه الذكرى) أي: يحصل له اتعاظ وانزجار عن المحارم،

JISHUMI:v10p7279/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7279/r4.speaker: عاصم
JISHUMI:v10p7279/r4.claim: ʿĀṣim reads fatanfaʿahu with fatḥah on the ʿayn as a subjunctive result after laʿalla and fa; the others read it with ḍammah, coordinated with yuzakkā and yadhdhakkaru.
JISHUMI:v10p7279/r4.anchor: قرأ عاصم: فتنفعه بنصب. العين على جواب (لعل) بالفاء

JISHUMI:v10p7281/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r8.claim: The blind man might purify himself through good deeds and avoiding sins, or remember God’s signs and benefit from that remembrance.
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r8.anchor: أي: لا تدري (لعله يزكى) يتطهر بالأعمال الصالحة، والتجنب من الذنوب والقبائح أو يذكر أي: يذكر آيات الله،

JISHUMI:v10p7281/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas and Ibn Zayd explain ‘remember’ as taking heed, so the admonition may benefit him.
JISHUMI:v10p7281/r9.anchor: وقيل: (أو يذكر) أي: يتعظ (فتنفعه) الموعظة، عن ابن عباس، وابن زيد.

JISHUMI:v10p7284/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7284/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7284/r1.claim: The author calls remembrance worship and says whoever wills can remember; this wording shows people are capable agents and that the act is theirs.
JISHUMI:v10p7284/r1.anchor: ومنها: دلالة قوله: (فمن شاء ذكره) على أنه قادر مخير، وأن الفعل فعله؛ لأن الآية تقتضي ذلك

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.claim: Al-Suddi reads the sense as perhaps he is purified and remembers, and says the alif is connective or extra.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.anchor: قال السدي : لعله يزكى ويذكر , والألف صلة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.claim: Al-dhikra can mean understanding of religion or admonition.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.anchor: وفي الذكرى وجهان : أحدها : الفقه . الثاني : العظة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Prophet would spread his cloak for Ibn Umm Maktum to sit on when he saw him approach, honoring him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.anchor: قال ابن عباس : فكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا نظر إليه مقبلا بسط له رداءه

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.claim: Qatada says the Prophet appointed Ibn Umm Maktum to lead the people’s prayers in Medina during two military expeditions.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.anchor: قال قتادة : واستخلفه على صلاة الناس بالمدينة في غزاتين من غزواته

MUQATIL:80:1-7/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:80:1-7/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:80:1-7/r5.claim: The reminder is an admonition: if Islam is presented to him and he believes, it will benefit him.
MUQATIL:80:1-7/r5.anchor: يعني الموعظة، يقول: أن تعرض عليه الإسلام فيؤمن فتنفعه تلك الذكرى

QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r8.claim: “Or be admonished” means take heed of what you say; “the reminder may benefit him” means the admonition itself.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r8.anchor: { أو يذكر } يتعظ بما تقول { فتنفعه الذكرى } أي العظة

QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r9.claim: The common reading has “fatanafaʿuhu” in the indicative, coordinated with “yazzakka.”
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r9.anchor: وقراءة العامة «فتنفعه» بضم العين، عطفا على «يزكى»

QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r10.speaker: عاصم وابن أبي إسحاق وعيسى
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r10.claim: Asim, Ibn Abi Ishaq, and Isa read the verb in the subjunctive as a response to “laʿalla,” which is non-assertive; the reading is also attributed to al-Sulami and Zirr ibn Hubaysh.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:1-4#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ عاصم وابن أبي إسحاق وعيسى «فتنفعه» نصبا. وهي قراءة السلمي وزر بن حبيش، على جواب لعل
